cases.task: In more_itertools.intersperse, non-positive separation n <= 0 is inconsistent: n=0 raises ValueError('n must be > 0'), while negative n falls through to chunked and raises ValueError('n must be at least 0'). Consistently reject all non-positive integers n <= 0 with ValueError('n must be > 0') at call time. Preserve positive separation behavior, empty iterables, and fill values. Add regression tests to IntersperseTest in tests/test_more.py and run that class.
